discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 to packets 259/283; reuses their keys. 30 standard WebSearches, snippets only, blocked domains on every query. Resolved: parks wave 2 numbers (Hercules 732, Hades 731, Woody 890), Doctor Strange 880 (FiGPiN) / Scarlet Witch 879 (retailer), SDCC 2023 numbers (Groot 1396, Jafar 955, Emperor 1281), Disney100 shopDisney Mickey 1140 / Minnie 1139 = wave-4 pins (retailer evidence; duplicate hold released). Narrowed: shopDisney UK grouping for 1024/1025/1160/1161 confirmed by FiGPiN roundup, scope conflict kept. New: Toynk SDCC 2022 Encanto Candle, Aladdin 30th, Lilo & Stitch 20th; Funko Rapunzel (Gold) with Pin 2022; X-Men '97 box set record; Hooked & Company Disney 100 set (2023); Amazon Disney Pets set (2022, held). Open: Her Universe Lead/Innovate, Leia Rebel, D23 Tigger number, box set members, Disney100 wave 2 edition, Amazon Alice/Ariel and Halloween makers.
